item.description:
CoreBlow 2.1.2

Highlights

  • Security: Patched 4 critical CVEs (tar >=7.5.19, proxy-addr >=2.0.8, simple-git >=4.0.1, @simple-git/argv-parser >=2.0.1) with 0 critical vulnerabilities.
  • Control UI: Bundled and verified release build of CoreBlow Control UI with zero doctor warnings.
  • Governance: Enforced automated release-sync contract gate (scripts/check-release-sync.mjs) across versions, paths, and brand sovereignty.
  • Architecture: Complete synchronization of sovereign microkernel specifications and companion surfaces.
